Batch Delete

The BatchDelete function in Manager.io allows you to delete multiple rows simultaneously, streamlining your data management process.

Steps to Use BatchDelete

  1. Initiate BatchDelete
    Click on the BatchDelete button in the relevant tab where you want to delete items. This action will add a new column with checkboxes to the list view.

  2. Select Rows to Delete
    Go through the list and select the checkboxes next to the rows you wish to remove. You can select as many rows as needed.

  3. Confirm Deletion
    After selecting the desired rows, scroll to the bottom of the screen and click the BatchDelete button again. This will complete the deletion process for the selected rows.

Notes

  • Be cautious when deleting data, as this action may be irreversible.
  • Ensure that you have selected the correct rows before confirming the deletion.
